title: Schedule of Hold Shares for Charges Held Out of Payment Arrangements by Late Payment Record
content:
**Schedule — share of the selected charges held back from the amount moved**
Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)

How much of the charges selected to be held back from the amount moved into the agreement is held back follows the late payment record of the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule account: the number of late payment charges billed on the service account in the twelve months ending on the transfer day.

| Charges selected to be held back | Late payment charges billed in the twelve months ending on the transfer day | Share held back |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 2 or more | 100 percent (1.0) of them |
| yes | fewer than 2 | 50 percent (0.5) of them |
| no charge selected | — | nothing |

**Boundary**

| Late payment charges in the twelve months | Share of the selected charges held back |
|---|---|
| 0 | 50 percent |
| 1 | 50 percent |
| 2 | 100 percent |
| 3 | 100 percent |

**Hypothetical:** selected charges of $31.40 are held back as $31.40 on an account billed 2 late payment charges in the twelve months and as $15.70 on an account billed 1.
